name: electron-fp-automation
//: Module-type marker. The packaged copy lives under out/Default/, whose package.json is type:module for the TS toolchain; with no nearer marker Node would resolve resources/automation/**/*.js as ESM, and the app's require('../automation/electron/wire') would throw - swallowed by the one-liner's try/catch, producing a silent no-bridge run. Keep this file CommonJS and copy it with the tree.
